$Comment: Ice King rune (2026-10-22): the king's burst of 5 bolts: a freeze if all hit. Same frost/freeze effects as the king (AT_Ice_King_Frost_Hit, guarded freeze). Icon and rune-stone texture: the ice symbol for this rune (ice_runes.py, 2026-10-22). No recipe yet.
